v41AltFailureDiagnosis.summary: BTC-tuned 1h v3.0 failed on ETHUSDT.P (-100.77%) and SOLUSDT.P (-131.54%) in v4.1 due to three structural mismatches:

factors.detail: Cal+Val median 1h ATR% is 0.934% on ETH (1.42x BTC 0.657%) and 1.261% on SOL (1.92x BTC). BTC stopAtr=3.2 produced 3.43% average stops on ETH and 4.69% on SOL while fixed beOffsetPct=0.34% captured only ~0.10R on ETH and ~0.07R on SOL, creating severe negative payoff skew amplified by VolNorm (riskPct=5%, maxLev=3.0).

The BTC-tuned slThresh=2 adaptive polarity flip inverted ETH/SOL signals during brief volatility clusters, dragging Cal+Val 1x performance from +19.27% (68.18% WR, PF 1.10) raw to -21.34% (63.19% WR, PF 0.90) on ETH and from -13.26% (61.85% WR, PF 0.96) raw to -55.93% (57.80% WR, PF 0.83) on SOL.

factors.factor: HTF Trend Lag & Shallow Pullback Limit
factors.detail: 4H EMA50 (200h) lagged altcoin momentum reversals and 0.18 ATR limit pullbacks chased intrabar spikes. Switching to faster 4H EMA20 (80h), deeper limit pullback (0.22-0.25 ATR), tighter stopAtr (2.0-2.2), and volatility-proportional BE+ offset (0.45%) restores positive Cal+Val expectancy.
